chapter: Small groups, Europe and Kansas City memories (repeated passages)
title: Learning positions, reading and a first taste of arranging
summary: A bandleader wrote slide positions over the notes to teach him to read; being fired suddenly pushed him to arrange his own parts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
